move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer—it seems this project matters to you beyond the immediate sale. We recognise the strain caused by late payments and will ensure reliable, on-time payment. How can that payment certainty translate into a more competitive price for the new series?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.70 per unit, 45 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
